reason: Reproduced on cards.issue-card-error: after Create card, the message Please complete this field appears under Control type in a plain span with no role, no aria-live and no live ancestor. Focus stays on the Create card button, and the page's only alert region (toast-container, role=alert) stays empty for 3 seconds. A screen-reader user hears nothing after pressing Create card, but the Control type field is exposed as invalid with its error text, so they can find the cause by exploring the form: possible but hard, so medium.

reason: The Select budgets combobox carries autocomplete="garbage" next to data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore and data-bwignore, a deliberate switch-off of browser autofill. It picks which existing budgets a card draws from, not information about the user, so no 1.3.5 input purpose applies.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and whose purpose is one of the 53 listed input purposes. Select budgets chooses company budgets for a card, which no listed purpose covers. The invalid token (autocomplete="garbage", set beside data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore and data-bwignore) is a deliberate autofill switch-off that browsers ignore, so no listed purpose is left unidentified. The accessibility tree exposes the combobox with its name and state intact, so 4.1.2 is not affected either.
